model: Cavalar-Oliveira full graph cover complexity, ECCC TR25-033

enumeration_contract.semifilter_representation: all nonempty antichains of nonempty subsets of the complement ground set
enumeration_contract.above_edge_filter: contains both complement star traces for at least one graph edge
enumeration_contract.pair_failure: E and H belong to F while E intersection H does not belong to F
enumeration_contract.optimization: exact set cover over all pair-failure masks after dominated-mask removal

regression_tests: published G_NEQ full-cover calibration at N=2 and N=4
explicit two-pair witness covers every relevant semi-filter
limitations: finite computation is not an asymptotic lower bound
no isolated independent review is bound
